title: TOEIC® Reading - Versión 10: Strategic Planning & Restructuring
description: Evaluación lectora de gramática, vocabulario y correspondencia formal para Summit Media.

parts.visual:
## 📖 Simulación Lectora: Summit Media

Analizaremos el memorándum oficial redactado por **the CEO** para la transición del software **ActiveCRM**.

Lee el documento con sumo cuidado.
parts.audio: Welcome to the Reading Section. Focus on prepositions, vocabulary in context, and direct information inside the memorandum.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Choose the word that best completes the sentence:

"The management board at Summit Media decided to inspect the factory ___ to ensure high compliance."
questions.explanation: Se necesita el adverbio 'periodically' para modificar la acción de inspeccionar (inspect).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the following document and answer: **What is the mandatory event's goal?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Division Heads
*From:* Chief Executive Officer
*Subject: Corporate Strategy & ActiveCRM Targets*

Please note that starting next Monday, all quarterly key performance indicators must be logged in ActiveCRM. An alignment meeting will be held this weekend at 5:00 PM in the Conference West Wing.
options: To test the internet speed in the office rooms.
To undergo training and receive user accounts for the new software.
To debate if they should stay with the old software.
To meet their supplier for lunch.
questions.correct_answer: To undergo training and receive user accounts for the new software.
questions.explanation: El memorando indica que la sesión es obligatoria porque las cuentas se aprovisionarán directamente ('accounts will be provisioned directly during the workshop').
